name: TSMC’s N2 nanosheet foundry process
description: TSMC put its first-generation nanosheet logic process into high-volume manufacturing and subsequently reported its ramp at Hsinchu and Kaohsiung.

date.label: Q4 2025
date.basis: The foundry confirms onset in the fourth quarter without giving the month.

events.statement: TSMC began high-volume manufacture of its N2 nanosheet process.
events.place_note: The more specific locations are documented for the later ramp, without separate Q4 start dates.

evidence.supports: TSMC identifies first-generation nanosheets and dates volume manufacture to Q4 2025.

evidence.locator: Printed p. 5, C. C. Wei prepared remarks, N2 and A14
evidence.supports: TSMC confirms the production milestone retrospectively and names the two sites in the subsequent ramp.

date.label: Q3 2026
date.basis: TSMC’s financial release reports shipments across the quarter ended September 30.

events.statement: TSMC reported 2 nm shipments accounting for 8% of its consolidated wafer revenue in the September quarter.
events.caveats: Revenue share across the company is not wafer count, fab throughput or the customer mix.

evidence.locator: Printed p. 1, wafer revenue by node, quarter ended September 30
evidence.supports: Wafer revenue breakdown attributes 8% to the 2 nm category.

date.basis: Date or date granularity stated in the cited source.

events.statement: TSMC reported an ongoing N2 ramp in multiple phases at Hsinchu and Kaohsiung.
events.caveats: This is an operator snapshot as of the call. It does not date initial production at each site.

evidence.locator: Printed p. 5, C. C. Wei prepared remarks, N2 and A14
evidence.supports: The operator states that N2 is ramping at both named sites during the call.

earliest_record.rationale: The scoped record is high-volume N2 manufacturing, with the onset bounded to Q4 2025 by its operator.

unresolved.note: Published evidence about each fab’s scanner models and layer assignments has not been located. The TSMC–ASML roadmap dates TSMC’s high-volume High-NA intent to 2030, rather than documenting N2 scanner assignments.
